meta.title: HKU campus recycling rules (component level)
meta.scope: Packaging components handled by the HKU re Campaign (re Kiosk + Smart Recycling Bins).
meta.note: effective_date is the date this rule was last verified against source.url. Replace with the official policy effective date once the Estates Office document numbers are confirmed.

sources.name: HKU re Campaign - Recycling 101 Photo Guide
HKU re Campaign - re Kiosk accepted recyclables

rules.title: Instant noodle container lid
rules.instruction: The lid of an instant noodle container is not accepted at the re Kiosk. Tear it off and put it in a general waste bin; only the cup or bowl goes into the plastic slot.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - Recycling 101 Photo Guide (Instant noodle container: Lid - not accepted)

rules.title: Instant noodle cup or bowl
rules.instruction: Empty and rinse the cup or bowl, remove the lid and any food residue, then place it in the plastic slot at the re Kiosk.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - Recycling 101 Photo Guide (Instant noodle container: the cup/bowl - plastic)

rules.title: Beverage carton / Tetra Pak
rules.instruction: Empty and rinse the carton, flatten it, then place it in the Tetra Pak slot at the re Kiosk. A clean take-away coffee cup belongs here too - its plastic lid and paper sleeve are separated.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - Recycling 101 Photo Guide (Take-away coffee cup: Clean cup - tetra pak)

rules.title: Plastic cup lid or bottle cap
rules.instruction: A clean plastic lid or cap goes into the plastic slot at the re Kiosk. Rinse off drink residue first and keep it separate from the cup.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - Recycling 101 Photo Guide (Take-away coffee cup: Clean lid - plastic)

rules.title: Paper cup sleeve
rules.instruction: The paper sleeve from a take-away cup goes into the paper slot at the re Kiosk.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - Recycling 101 Photo Guide (Take-away coffee cup: Cup Sleeve - paper)

rules.title: Clean pizza box
rules.instruction: Only a clean pizza box is accepted. Remove food residue and grease-stained sections, flatten the box and place it in the paper slot.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - Recycling 101 Photo Guide (Paper: Clean pizza box - paper)

rules.title: Baking paper / parchment
rules.instruction: Baking paper is not accepted at the re Kiosk because of its silicone or wax coating. Put it in a general waste bin.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - Recycling 101 Photo Guide (Baking paper - not accepted)

rules.title: Glass bottle or jar
rules.instruction: Rinse the glass bottle or jar and place it in the glass slot at the re Kiosk. On campus, glass is accepted at the re Kiosk and at the Smart Recycling Bins at Central Podium Levels and Pine Court only.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - re Kiosk accepted recyclables (Glass Bottle) / Smart Recycling Bins coverage

rules.title: Aluminium or tin can
rules.instruction: Empty and rinse the can, do not crush it flat if you can avoid it, then place it in the metal slot at the re Kiosk or a Smart Recycling Bin.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - re Kiosk accepted recyclables (Metal)

rules.title: Plastic (PET) bottle
rules.instruction: Empty and rinse the bottle, remove the cap and put both into the plastic slot at the re Kiosk or a Smart Recycling Bin.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - re Kiosk accepted recyclables (Plastic) / Smart Recycling Bins (Plastic bottle)

rules.title: Styrofoam box or tray (cleaned)
rules.instruction: Styrofoam is accepted only when it is cleaned with no food residue. Rinse and dry it, then place it in the plastic slot at the re Kiosk.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - Recycling 101 Photo Guide (Styrofoam - cleaned, plastic)

rules.title: Contact lens packaging tray
rules.instruction: The plastic tray of contact lens packaging goes into the plastic slot at the re Kiosk. The foil lid is not accepted - peel it off and bin it as general waste.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - Recycling 101 Photo Guide (Contact lens packaging: Tray - plastic, Foil lid - not accepted)

rules.title: Paper, newspaper, cardboard box
rules.instruction: Keep paper clean and dry, flatten boxes, then place it in the paper slot at the re Kiosk or a Smart Recycling Bin.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - re Kiosk accepted recyclables (Paper)

rules.title: Other plastic packaging
rules.instruction: Clean plastic packaging is accepted at the re Kiosk. Rinse off food and drink residue and dry it before dropping it into the plastic slot.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - Recycling 101 Photo Guide (Plastic packaging - plastic)

rules.title: Rechargeable battery / power bank
rules.instruction: Rechargeable batteries are collected separately at the re Kiosk. Tape the terminals and hand them in at the battery slot - never put them in a general waste bin.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - re Kiosk accepted recyclables (Rechargeable Battery)

rules.title: Out-of-scope item (hazardous or bulky)
rules.instruction: This item is outside the scope of the campus packaging recycling rules. Do not put it in a recycling bin - contact the Estates Office or a specialist collection point instead.

source.name: HKU re Campaign - Recycling 101 scope (paper / tetra pak / metal / glass / plastic / rechargeable battery only)
